rationale.condition_agreement: The hypothesis mentions dealloying at high temperatures and improved properties under elevated temperatures and moderate irradiation, while the paper used 1200 °C for 96 h, measured thermal conductivity up to ~800 °C, and screened with 25 keV He+ irradiation. The hypothesis captures the same broad regime (high-temperature LMD, elevated-temperature service, irradiation) but lacks the paper's specific temperature, time, and irradiation energy/fluence details.
